items.title: Quarterly Report of City Manager Purchases and Contract Awards FY 24-25 Q3
items.recommendation: Receive and file reports.
items.description: Quarterly report pursuant to Beaumont Municipal Code Sections 3.01.030(B), 3.01.040(B), and 3.01.050(B).

items.title: Grants Quarterly Report Q3 FY2024-2025
items.recommendation: Receive and file report.
items.description: Quarterly Grants Reporting from January 1, 2025, through March 31, 2025.

items.title: Performance Bond Exoneration
items.recommendation: Authorize City staff to issue a Bond Exoneration Letter for Performance and Payment Bonds and Accept Maintenance Bonds for (Project / Bond Number / Improvement): Tract Map No. 27971-7 / PB03010407421 / Street and Storm Drain
items.description: Performance and payment bond exoneration for street and storm drain improvements associated with Tract Map No. 27971-7.

items.title: Accept Public Improvements and Exonerate Maintenance Bond
items.recommendation: Accept the public improvements, authorize the Mayor to sign the Certificate of Acceptance, and authorize staff to issue a bond exoneration letter for maintenance bonds for (Project / Receipt Number / Improvement): • APN 419-202-005 / R01373615 / Sewer
items.description: Maintenance bond exoneration for sewer improvements associated with APN 419-202-005.

items.title: Fiscal Year 2024 City of Beaumont, California Transit System
items.recommendation: It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the Fiscal Year 2024 City of Beaumont, California Transit System.
items.description: Approve the Fiscal Year 2024 Transit Audit Report.

items.title: Second Reading to Amend Beaumont Municipal Code Chapter 2.24 “Planning Commission and Community Development Department”
items.recommendation: Waive the full second reading and approve by title only, “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Beaumont, California, Amending Chapter 2.24 ‘Planning Commission and Community Development Department’, of the Beaumont Municipal Code”.
items.description: Proposed amendments to update sections within the chapter to include primary residence requirement and other housekeeping updates.

items.title: Consent to Transfer – Verizon Wireless Lease at 11250 Palmer Avenue
items.recommendation: Authorize the Mayor to sign the consent form related to Vertical Bridge’s management of Verizon’s leased site at 11250 Palmer Avenue.
items.description: Authorize the Mayor to sign a consent form acknowledging and approving Vertical Bridge’s lease and site management arrangement related to Verizon's telecommunication facility located at 11250 Palmer Avenue.

items.title: Adoption of the City of Beaumont 2025 Strategic Plan
items.recommendation: Approve and adopt the City of Beaumont 2025 Strategic Plan.
items.description: This report presents the final draft of the City of Beaumont Strategic Plan 2025 for review and adoption. The plan outlines the City’s core strategic priorities, goals, and action steps for FY 2025/2026.

items.title: Follow-Up Report No. 3 – Local State of Emergency – Sewer Mainline Failure and Emergency Repairs in Fairway Canyon
items.recommendation: Direct staff to return at the next Council meeting with a follow-up report on emergency response efforts, expenditures, and timeline updates.
items.description: Local emergency due to the sewer mainline failure in Fairway Canyon.

items.title: Public Hearing - Letter of Action from the California Uniform Construction Cost Accounting Commission (CUCCAC) dated February 14, 2025
items.recommendation: Hold a public hearing; and Acknowledge receipt of CUCCAC’s letter dated February 14, 2025.
items.description: Hold a public hearing in accordance with Public Contract Code 22044(b).

items.title: Temporary Suspension and Revision of BMC Ch. 17.11.050 – Offsite Improvements
items.recommendation: Hold a Public Hearing and; Waive the first full reading and approve by title only: “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City Of Beaumont, California, Suspending Enforcement of Beaumont Municipal Code Section 17.11.050 and Providing A Redline Version for Consideration as Part of the Zoning Code Update” And; Adopt the Resolution and approve by title only, “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Beaumont Establishing A Temporary Suspension on the Enforcement of Off-Site Improvement Requirements In BMC 17.11.050.”
items.description: Public hearing and consideration of a proposed temporary suspension and revision of Beaumont Municipal Code Section 17.11.050 – Offsite Improvements to provide relief to single-family residential property owners seeking to make improvements to their property.

items.title: Continue the Public Hearing to Consider a Resolution Repealing the Noble Creek Vistas Specific Plan
items.recommendation: Open the public hearing, take testimony and continue the item to the June 3, 2025, City Council meeting.
items.description: Resolution to repeal the Noble Creek Vistas Specific Plan.

items.title: Continue the Public Hearing PLAN2025-0164 Beaumont Municipal Code Amendment to Chapter 17.11.110 Home Occupations
items.recommendation: Open the public hearing, take testimony, and continue the item to the May 6, 2025, City Council meeting.
items.description: Public hearing and consideration of proposed amendments to Beaumont Municipal Code Chapter 17.11 “General Development Standards”, more specifically Chapter 17.02.110 “Home Occupations”.

items.title: Authorize the Fourth Amendment to the City Manager Employment Agreement
items.recommendation: Authorize the Mayor to sign the Fourth Amendment to the City Manager Employment Contract.
items.description: The City Council and City Manager engage in labor negotiations on an annual basis as it relates to the anniversary of the appointment date at City Manager with the City, April 11, 2023.

items.title: Approve a Memorandum of Understanding with the Cherry Festival Association for the 2025 Cherry Festival Event
items.recommendation: Discuss the draft MOU and approve the Mayor signing on behalf of the City; OR Discuss the draft MOU and make any changes necessary.
items.description: Co-sponsorship and additional support for the 2025 Cherry Festival, including public safety, expanded shuttle service, parking support, and traffic control operations.

items.title: Discussion on the State Fire Marshal’s Updated Fire Hazard Severity Zone (FHSZ) Maps for Local Responsibility Areas
items.recommendation: Receive and file. This item is informational only. A public hearing will be scheduled to adopt an ordinance in accordance with State law.
items.description: This report provides an overview of the recent Executive Order (EO) signed by the Governor and the release of updated Fire Hazard Severity Zone (FHSZ) maps for Local Responsibility Areas (LRA) by the Office of the State Fire Marshal. The update significantly expands designated fire hazard zones and includes regulatory implications for the City of Beaumont.

items.title: Discussion and Direction on Proceeding with the Acquisition of a Ladder Truck in Coordination with Riverside County Fire Department
items.recommendation: Staff recommends City Council direct the Riverside County Fire Department to proceed with the acquisition of the identified ladder truck to fulfill the City’s existing purchase request.
items.description: Discuss and provide direction to staff on proceeding with the acquisition of a readily available ladder truck identified by Riverside County Fire Department that meets all required specifications and may significantly reduce acquisition timelines.

items.title: Landscape Maintenance Agreement for Potrero Interchange
items.recommendation: Approve a Landscape Maintenance Agreement between the State of California, acting through the Department of Transportation (Caltrans), and the City of Beaumont for the Potrero Interchange and authorize the Mayor to execute the agreement on behalf of the City.
items.description: Landscape Maintenance Agreement between the State of California, acting through the Department of Transportation (Caltrans), and the City of Beaumont for the Potrero Interchange.

items.title: Provide Direction to Staff on the Community Recreation Center Overflow Parking Lot – Capital Improvement Project No. P-23
items.recommendation: Authorize staff to proceed with Option 3 to engage a consultant and bring a report back to Council on the findings of the consultant.
items.description: Capital Improvement Project P-23 (CIP) Update.

items.title: Memorandum of Understanding Between the City of Beaumont and the City of Banning for the Purchase of Compressed Natural Gas Fuel
items.recommendation: Authorize the City Manager to execute the MOU between the City of Beaumont and the City of Banning, allowing Beaumont to purchase Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) from the City of Banning’s fueling station.
items.description: A Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with the City of Banning to allow the City of Beaumont to purchase Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) fuel for its transit vehicles from Banning’s existing fueling facility.

items.title: Award of Professional Services Agreement to Evergreen Solutions in an Amount Not to Exceed $182,400 for a Classification and Compensation Study
items.recommendation: Authorize the Mayor to sign a Professional Services Agreement with Evergreen Solutions in the amount of $152,000 for a term of one year; and Authorize the City Manager to approve any contingency up to an amount of $30,400 (20%) for change orders, for a not to exceed amount of $182,400.
items.description: In preparation for negotiations City Council has directed staff to conduct a comprehensive classification and compensation study.
